newsitem.title: UK: Briton pays $128,300 for personal car number plate.
newsitem.headline: Briton pays $128,300 for personal car number plate.

text.p: A businessman from southern England paid 77,550 pounds ($128,300) at a London auction for a car registration number to match his first name -- N1 GEL.
Auctioneers said on Friday the sale of 80 registration numbers totalled 1.6 million pounds with British and Hong Kong buyers bidding keenly for everything from 1 P to BAS 1L.
"This traditional pre-Christmas auction certainly appealed to our more affluent clientele," said Byron Roberts, marketing manager for the transport department's registration office.
